name: Jellyfin2 PopFeed
description: Automatically post watched movies to PopFeed via AT Protocol. When you finish a movie on Jellyfin, it checks if it already exists on your PopFeed feed and posts it if it's new.

versions.changelog: Complete config page rewrite. Single-trip API calls (no race conditions). Persistent connected badge with handle/pdsHost and Disconnect button. Server-side merge for Save Settings (preserves tokens). Leave password blank to keep existing.
